author: Lindsay Walker
claim: Hedera exact scheme uses a partially signed tx; facilitator (Blocky402) pays gas and submits. Blocky402 listed as multi-network facilitator including Hedera testnet.
limitations: February 2026 explainer; facilitator feature set may have changed. Older than 90 days — labeled.

title: x402 bounty on Hedera winners announced
author: Jake Hall
claim: Testnet winners: Pinout (metered session + on-chain unused refund), Tally (non-EVM upto), Xorv (idle AI-quota marketplace), Qisma (atomic multi-payee CryptoTransfer), Mystic (VPN minutes).
limitations: Testnet; note that some repos may be privatized after judging. Xorv resale terms not independently reviewed.

title: Get discovered (Bazaar)
author: Coinbase Developer Platform
claim: Indexing requires a successful settled payment through CDP. 30 days without settlement removes the listing. Ranking uses usage plus metadata quality; curation is editorial.
limitations: CDP Bazaar only; x402.org facilitator has a separate catalog.

title: Payment Schemes — x402
author: x402 Foundation
claim: Schemes are exact, upto, and batch-settlement. Flows: authorization (default), upfront (exact only), escrow. upto/batch-settlement are authorization-only.
limitations: SDK/network support varies; Hedera bindings are referenced at spec level, not re-tested.

title: Scheme: batch-settlement
author: x402 Foundation
claim: batch-settlement verifies a commitment at request time and moves value later; supports charging below the authorized max; idle channels can refund.
limitations: Raw spec via search snippet, not a full rendered docs walkthrough of the EVM binding.

title: Privy policies overview
author: Privy
claim: Policies are lists of rules/conditions on wallet RPCs; default DENY if no matching allow rule. Supports transfer limits, recipient/network allowlists, calldata constraints, and stateful aggregations.
limitations: Chain types listed do not include Hedera; Hedera signing may need a different Privy path than EVM policy objects.

title: Using x402 to Pay for Subgraph Data on The Graph Network
author: The Graph
